items.opus_reason: the method leads back to basic collective attitudes: the terminus reached on the method's arc; derivation and instrumentality considered
items.gemini_reason: A method that 'leads back to' a result functions as the means by which that result is reached.

items.subject: undifferentiated-function

refs.quote: So long as a function is still so fused with one or more other functions ... it is in an archaic (q.v.) condition

items.opus_reason: a fused function 'is in an archaic condition', i.e. is archaic (cf. concretism is-a archaism); property no-family considered
items.gemini_reason: Property attribution ('exhibits', 'is in a condition') is a recorded gap with no family.

items.subject: empathy

refs.quote: EMPATHY 36 is an introjection (q.v.) of the object.

items.opus_reason: empathy as introjection of the object: relocation of psychic content between subject and object, converse of projection; classification considered
items.gemini_reason: Empathy is classified as an instance of introjection.

items.subject: enantiodromia

refs.quote: I use the term enantiodromia for the emergence of the unconscious opposite in the course of time.

items.opus_reason: enantiodromia is the emergence of the unconscious opposite: the less formulable term showing itself, inverse direction like 'antichrist manifests enantiodromia'; no-family considered
items.gemini_reason: The quote ('I use the term... for') is an explicit act of naming/defining by the author.

items.subject: extraversion

refs.quote: EXTRAVERSION is an outward-turning of libido (q.v.).

items.opus_reason: 'an outward-turning of libido': kind of libido movement, same shape as abstraction is-introverting-movement-of libido
items.gemini_reason: Defining a concept as a specific dynamic process ('outward-turning of') does not fit the existing families.

items.subject: freud

refs.quote: As we know, Freud has made intensive use of this method. It is a method of interpretation which I call reductive (q.v.).

items.opus_reason: Freud's use of the reductive method is a named carrier's interpretive practice; instrumentality considered
items.gemini_reason: A figure 'using' a method is an action that does not fit doctrinal-attribution (which requires predication) or other families.

items.subject: fantasy

refs.quote: Purposively interpreted, it seems like a symbol , seeking to characterize a definite goal

items.opus_reason: purposively interpreted, fantasy is a symbol; 'seems like' hedges toward correspondence
items.gemini_reason: Likening one term to another ('seems like a symbol') asserts a structural parallel without identity.

items.subject: active-feeling

refs.quote: Hence active feeling is a directed function, an act of the will (q.v.)

items.opus_reason: active feeling is a directed function, an act of the will: kind; instrumentality considered
items.gemini_reason: An 'act of the will' implies that active feeling is produced or brought forth by the will, fitting the inverse direction of generation.

items.subject: idea

refs.quote: I use the term idea to express the meaning of a primordial image

items.opus_reason: idea is the formulated showing of the less formulable primordial image (inverse/aspect direction); considered symbolization via the dogma-expresses precedent, but idea is not an image
items.gemini_reason: "expresses-meaning-of" asserts that the subject formulates or describes the object, fitting symbolization.

items.subject: identification

refs.quote: IDENTIFICATION . By this I mean a psychological process in which the personality is partially or totally dissimilated (v. Assimilation ).

items.opus_reason: quote defines identification as a process of dissimilation (kind-of); considered composition on the 'involves' string
items.gemini_reason: "involves" asserts inclusion or parthood, fitting composition.

items.subject: identity

refs.quote: Identity with the parents provides the basis for subsequent identification (q.v.) with them

items.opus_reason: identity is the precondition for subsequent identification (standing requirement satisfied before); basis language also touches the based-on/foundation known ambiguity (derivation vs position)
items.gemini_reason: "basis" implies foundation, which defaults to structural-position, though it borders derivation's "based-on".

items.subject: identity

refs.quote: Identity is primarily an unconscious conformity with objects.

items.opus_reason: identity defined as conformity with objects; no family fits a definitional likeness-to-object claim; considered correspondence
items.gemini_reason: "conformity with" asserts agreement or structural likeness, fitting correspondence.

items.subject: idea

refs.quote: The further development of thought leads to the idea, which is nothing other than the primordial image intellectually formulated.

items.opus_reason: idea is nothing other than the primordial image formulated: same content in another guise (inverse direction); considered transformation (development of thought leads to)
items.gemini_reason: "is-formulation-of" directly matches the definition of symbolization as a formulation of a fact.

items.subject: individuation

refs.quote: A conscious process of differentiation (q.v.), or individuation (q.v.), is needed to bring the individuality to consciousness

items.opus_reason: individuation is the process needed to bring individuality to consciousness (the means); considered psychic-effect
items.gemini_reason: "brings-to-consciousness" is a dynamic act producing a state in the object, fitting psychic-effect.

items.subject: inferior-function

refs.quote: This term is used to denote the function that lags behind in the process of differentiation (q.v.).

items.opus_reason: lags behind = stated deficiency in differentiation; considered structural-position (ordinal place)
items.gemini_reason: 'lags-behind-in' describes a temporal/processual state not strictly covered by sequence or structural-position.

items.subject: inferior-function

refs.quote: the inferior function remains conscious, at least in its effects; but in a neurosis it sinks wholly or in part into the unconscious.

items.opus_reason: claim is where the function goes (into the unconscious), a place claim; considered no-family
items.gemini_reason: 'sinks-into' is a dynamic spatial metaphor that does not cleanly fit structural-position or transformation.

items.subject: introversion

refs.quote: INTROVERSION means an inward-turning of libido (q.v.), in the sense of a negative relation of subject to object.

items.opus_reason: introversion is a mode/showing of libido (inverse aspect direction, libido persists); considered no-family
items.gemini_reason: 'is-inward-turning-of' is a specific dynamic definition that lacks a dedicated family.

items.subject: introverted-type

refs.quote: When introversion is habitual, we speak of an introverted type (q.v.).

items.opus_reason: introverted type is the habitual form of introversion (inverse aspect direction); considered classification
items.gemini_reason: 'is-habitual-form-of' describes a typological manifestation not cleanly covered by classification or manifestation.

items.subject: orientation

refs.quote: ORIENTATION . I use this term to denote the general principle governing an attitude (q.v.).

items.opus_reason: 'general principle governing' = governing-principle, routed to no-family; considered dependence (rulership)
items.gemini_reason: The relation 'governs' asserts rulership, which falls under the dependence family.

items.subject: power-complex

refs.quote: the whole complex of ideas and strivings which seek to subordinate all other influences to the ego (q.v.)

items.opus_reason: subordination of influences to the ego; considered telos ('seek to') and psychic-effect
items.gemini_reason: The relation 'subordinates-influences-to' is a complex three-place action that does not fit neatly into the binary dependence or psychic-effect families.

items.subject: reason

refs.quote: Human reason, accordingly, is nothing other than the expression of man’s adaptability to average occurrences

items.opus_reason: reason is nothing other than the expression of adaptability (inverse aspect direction); considered symbolization, but object is not a relatively unknown fact
items.gemini_reason: The relation 'expresses' acts as a formulation of a less formulable term (adaptation), parallel to the document's 'expresses' placement under symbolization.
